# People Atlas 0.4.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.4.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release makes common family relationships quicker to enter while keeping
People Atlas explicit and Markdown-first.

Obsidian 1.13 is now publicly available for desktop and mobile. Publishing
People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate step from
this GitHub release.

## Changes

- Added a **Simple relationship** selector for Parent, Child and Sibling. Each
  choice fills the two reciprocal neutral roles in the existing relationship
  form; Custom keeps manual and template-provided roles available.
- Added presentation-only family terms: resolved people with gender `woman`
  or `man` can appear as mother/father, daughter/son or sister/brother. Stored
  relationship roles remain `parent`, `child` or `sibling`.
- Kept neutral terms for missing or unsupported gender and for ghost or
  ambiguous people. Literal and translated custom roles remain unchanged.
- Preserved explicit Save as the only relationship-note write. People Atlas
  does not infer sibling or other relationships from shared parents or graph
  structure.
- Updated the published plugin author metadata to `TheBeems`.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
